description: Within-vehicle conditional logistic regression of death: odds ratios (models: main = unbelted + 8 age bands + sex + seat; coarse_age = 4 age bands; belt_by_seat_row = main + unbelted x second row; misreport_f = main after seeded random reclassification of a fraction f of belted survivors to unbelted)
population: FARS 2016-2024 occupants (driver/passenger) of in-transport light passenger vehicles, seat front-left/front-other/second row, age 13+, belted or unbelted, known outcome; vehicles with >= 2 eligible occupants and discordant outcomes
method: statsmodels ConditionalLogit (groups = vehicle), Newton-Raphson; CIs from crash-cluster-robust sandwich (primary) and model-based information; flag: suppressed = fewer than 30 persons with the term, unstable = robust SE(log OR) > 0.30
